Ui.Script:
local PREFIX = "RWBOTTLE" local BOTTLE_ITEMS = { [44625] = true, [800000] = true } local A_REROLL, A_GAMBLE, A_EMPOWER, A_AWAKEN, A_POUR = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 local TIER_COLOR = { "ffffffff", "ff1eff00", "ff0070dd", "ffa335ee", "ffff8000" } local SLOT_NAMES = { "Primary enchant", "Secondary enchant", "Bonus enchant" } local ROWS, SHELF = 19, 24
-- The last full state the server sent, and the one being collected (BEGIN to END). local B = { charges = 0, stored = 0, storedTier = 0, storedName = "", pour = 0, awaken = 0, items = {}, absorb = {}, pending = false, selected = nil, confirm = nil } local incoming = nil
local function split(text) local fields = {} for field in (text .. "\t"):gmatch("([^\t]*)\t") do fields[#fields + 1] = field end return fields end
local function send(text) SendAddonMessage(PREFIX, text, "WHISPER", UnitName("player")) end
-- The server numbers bag positions as the core does: the backpack is bag 255, slots -- 23-38; the equipped bags are 19-22, slots from 0. local function client_position(bag, slot) if bag == 255 then return 0, slot - 22 end return bag - 18, slot + 1 end
-- The frame ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local frame = CreateFrame("Frame", "RustWrathBottleFrame", UIParent) frame:Hide() frame:SetWidth(620) frame:SetHeight(600) frame:SetPoint("CENTER", UIParent, "CENTER", 0, 30) frame:SetFrameStrata("DIALOG") frame:SetToplevel(true) frame:EnableMouse(true) frame:SetMovable(true) frame:SetClampedToScreen(true) frame:RegisterForDrag("LeftButton") frame:SetScript("OnDragStart", function() frame:StartMoving() end) frame:SetScript("OnDragStop", function() frame:StopMovingOrSizing() end) frame:SetBackdrop({ bgFile = "Interface\\DialogFrame\\UI-DialogBox-Background", edgeFile = "Interface\\DialogFrame\\UI-DialogBox-Border", tile = true, tileSize = 32, edgeSize = 32, insets = { left = 11, right = 12, top = 12, bottom = 11 }, }) if UISpecialFrames then table.insert(UISpecialFrames, "RustWrathBottleFrame") end
local header = frame:CreateTexture(nil, "ARTWORK") header:SetTexture("Interface\\DialogFrame\\UI-DialogBox-Header") header:SetWidth(320) header:SetHeight(64) header:SetPoint("TOP", frame, "TOP", 0, 12) local title = frame:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormal") title:SetPoint("TOP", header, "TOP", 0, -14) title:SetText("Enchant Bottle")
local close = CreateFrame("Button", "RustWrathBottleFrameClose", frame, "UIPanelCloseButton") close:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", frame, "TOPRIGHT", -6, -6) close:SetScript("OnClick", function() frame:Hide() end)
-- The essence meter: charges against the next power of two from 16. local meter = CreateFrame("StatusBar", nil, frame) meter:SetWidth(380) meter:SetHeight(18) meter:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", frame, "TOPLEFT", 24, -38) meter:SetStatusBarTexture("Interface\\TargetingFrame\\UI-StatusBar") meter:SetStatusBarColor(0.55, 0.3, 1) meter:SetMinMaxValues(0, 16) meter:SetValue(0) local meterBack = meter:CreateTexture(nil, "BACKGROUND") meterBack:SetAllPoints(meter) meterBack:SetTexture(0, 0, 0, 0.6) local meterText = meter:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontHighlightSmall") meterText:SetPoint("CENTER", meter, "CENTER", 0, 0)
local imprint = frame:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalSmall") imprint:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", meter, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -6) imprint:SetWidth(570) imprint:SetJustifyH("LEFT")
local status = frame:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontHighlightSmall") status:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", frame, "BOTTOMLEFT", 24, 20) status:SetWidth(570) status:SetJustifyH("LEFT")
-- The equipped items, left. local rows = {} for i = 1, ROWS do local row = CreateFrame("Button", nil, frame) row:SetWidth(236) row:SetHeight(20) row:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", frame, "TOPLEFT", 20, -82 - (i - 1) * 20) row.icon = row:CreateTexture(nil, "ARTWORK") row.icon:SetWidth(18) row.icon:SetHeight(18) row.icon:SetPoint("LEFT", row, "LEFT", 2, 0) row.text = row:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontHighlightSmall") row.text:SetPoint("LEFT", row.icon, "RIGHT", 4, 0) row.text:SetWidth(208) row.text:SetJustifyH("LEFT") row.mark = row:CreateTexture(nil, "BACKGROUND") row.mark:SetAllPoints(row) row.mark:SetTexture("Interface\\QuestFrame\\UI-QuestTitleHighlight") row.mark:SetBlendMode("ADD") row.mark:Hide() row:SetHighlightTexture("Interface\\QuestFrame\\UI-QuestTitleHighlight", "ADD") row:SetScript("OnClick", function() B.selected = row.equip RustWrathBottle_Render() end) row:SetScript("OnEnter", function() if row.equip then GameTooltip:SetOwner(row, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetInventoryItem("player", row.equip + 1) GameTooltip:Show() end end) row:SetScript("OnLeave", function() GameTooltip:Hide() end) rows[i] = row end
-- One card per enchant slot of the selected item, right. local cards = {} for si = 1, 3 do local card = CreateFrame("Frame", nil, frame) card:SetWidth(334) card:SetHeight(116) card:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", frame, "TOPLEFT", 266, -82 - (si - 1) * 124) card:SetBackdrop({ bgFile = "Interface\\Tooltips\\UI-Tooltip-Background", edgeFile = "Interface\\Tooltips\\UI-Tooltip-Border", tile = true, tileSize = 16, edgeSize = 16, insets = { left = 4, right = 4, top = 4, bottom = 4 }, }) card:SetBackdropColor(0.06, 0.04, 0.12, 0.95) card.label = card:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalSmall") card.label:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", card, "TOPLEFT", 12, -10) card.label:SetText(SLOT_NAMES[si]) card.name = card:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontHighlight") card.name:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", card.label, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -8) card.name:SetWidth(310) card.name:SetJustifyH("LEFT") card.buttons = {} for b = 1, 3 do local button = CreateFrame("Button", "RustWrathBottleCard" .. si .. "Action" .. b, card, "UIPanelButtonTemplate") button:SetWidth(100) button:SetHeight(22) button:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", card, "BOTTOMLEFT", 10 + (b - 1) * 106, 12) button:SetScript("OnClick", function() if button.action then RustWrathBottle_Act(button.action, si) end end) button:SetScript("OnEnter", function() if button.tip then GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_TOP") GameTooltip:SetText(button.tip, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1) GameTooltip:Show() end end) button:SetScript("OnLeave", function() GameTooltip:Hide() end) button:Hide() card.buttons[b] = button end cards[si] = card end
-- The absorb shelf, bottom: the bag items with random enchants. local shelfLabel = frame:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalSmall") shelfLabel:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", frame, "TOPLEFT", 22, -462) shelfLabel:SetWidth(570) shelfLabel:SetJustifyH("LEFT") local shelf = {} for i = 1, SHELF do local slotButton = CreateFrame("Button", nil, frame) slotButton:SetWidth(30) slotButton:SetHeight(30) slotButton:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", frame, "TOPLEFT", 22 + ((i - 1) % 12) * 34, -480 - math.floor((i - 1) / 12) * 34) slotButton.icon = slotButton:CreateTexture(nil, "ARTWORK") slotButton.icon:SetAllPoints(slotButton) slotButton:SetHighlightTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\ButtonHilight-Square", "ADD") slotButton:SetScript("OnClick", function() local entry = slotButton.entry if entry and not B.pending then B.confirm = entry StaticPopup_Show("RUSTWRATH_BOTTLE_ABSORB", entry.name, entry.value) end end) slotButton:SetScript("OnEnter", function() local entry = slotButton.entry if entry then GameTooltip:SetOwner(slotButton, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetBagItem(client_position(entry.bag, entry.slot)) GameTooltip:AddLine(string.format("Click to absorb: +%d charge%s (destroys it)", entry.value, entry.value == 1 and "" or "s"), 0.7, 0.5, 1) GameTooltip:Show() end end) slotButton:SetScript("OnLeave", function() GameTooltip:Hide() end) slotButton:Hide() shelf[i] = slotButton end local shelfHint = frame:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontDisableSmall") shelfHint:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", frame, "TOPLEFT", 434, -482) shelfHint:SetWidth(166) shelfHint:SetJustifyH("LEFT") shelfHint:SetText("Disenchanting an item fills the bottle too, and imprints its best enchant.")
StaticPopupDialogs = StaticPopupDialogs or {} StaticPopupDialogs["RUSTWRATH_BOTTLE_ABSORB"] = { text = "Destroy %s for %d charges?", button1 = YES, button2 = NO, OnAccept = function() local entry = B.confirm B.confirm = nil if entry then B.pending = true send("ABSORB\t" .. entry.bag .. "\t" .. entry.slot) end end, timeout = 0, whileDead = 1, hideOnEscape = 1, showAlert = 1, }
-- Rendering ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function selected_item() for _, item in ipairs(B.items) do if item.equip == B.selected then return item end end return nil end
local function offer(button, action, label, cost, tip) button.action = action button.tip = tip button:SetText(label .. " " .. cost) if cost > B.charges or B.pending then button:Disable() else button:Enable() end button:Show() end
function RustWrathBottle_Render() local top = 16 while top < B.charges do top = top * 2 end meter:SetMinMaxValues(0, top) meter:SetValue(B.charges) meterText:SetText(string.format("Essence: %d charge%s", B.charges, B.charges == 1 and "" or "s")) if B.stored ~= 0 then imprint:SetText(string.format("Imprint: |c%s%s|r (T%d), pours for %d charges", TIER_COLOR[B.storedTier] or "ffffffff", B.storedName, B.storedTier, B.pour)) else imprint:SetText("Imprint: none yet. Disenchant or absorb an item to imprint its best enchant.") end
for i = 1, ROWS do local row, item = rows[i], B.items[i] if item then row.equip = item.equip local link = GetInventoryItemLink("player", item.equip + 1) local name, _, quality = GetItemInfo(link or item.entry) local color = quality and ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS and ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS[quality] local count = 0 for si = 1, 3 do if item.slots[si].tier > 0 then count = count + 1 end end row.text:SetText(((color and color.hex) or "|cffffffff") .. (name or ("item " .. item.entry)) .. "|r" .. (count > 0 and (" |cff9d9d9d(" .. count .. ")|r") or "")) row.icon:SetTexture(GetInventoryItemTexture("player", item.equip + 1) or GetItemIcon(item.entry)) if item.equip == B.selected then row.mark:Show() else row.mark:Hide() end row:Show() else row.equip = nil row:Hide() end end
local item = selected_item() for si = 1, 3 do local card = cards[si] for b = 1, 3 do card.buttons[b].action = nil card.buttons[b].tip = nil card.buttons[b]:Hide() end if not item then card.name:SetText(si == 1 and "|cff9d9d9dPick an equipped item on the left.|r" or "") else local s = item.slots[si] if s.id == 0 then card.name:SetText("|cff9d9d9dEmpty|r") offer(card.buttons[1], A_AWAKEN, "Awaken", B.awaken, "Fills the slot with a random enchant rolled from the item's quality, " .. "as strong as your charges pay for (1.5x its tier value). " .. "The cost shown is the least.") if B.stored ~= 0 then offer(card.buttons[2], A_POUR, "Pour", B.pour, "Pours the imprinted " .. B.storedName .. " into this slot and empties the imprint.") end elseif s.tier == 0 then card.name:SetText(s.name .. " |cff9d9d9d(not a random enchant)|r") else card.name:SetText(string.format("|c%s%s|r |cff9d9d9dT%d|r", TIER_COLOR[s.tier] or "ffffffff", s.name, s.tier)) offer(card.buttons[1], A_REROLL, "Reroll", s.reroll, "A different random enchant of the same tier.") offer(card.buttons[2], A_GAMBLE, "Gamble", s.reroll, "25% one tier down, 50% the same tier, 25% one tier up.") if s.empower > 0 then offer(card.buttons[3], A_EMPOWER, "Empower", s.empower, "The same stat, one tier up.") end end end end
for i = 1, SHELF do local slotButton, entry = shelf[i], B.absorb[i] if entry then slotButton.entry = entry local texture = GetContainerItemInfo(client_position(entry.bag, entry.slot)) slotButton.icon:SetTexture(texture or GetItemIcon(entry.entry)) slotButton:Show() else slotButton.entry = nil slotButton:Hide() end end if table.getn(B.absorb) > 0 then shelfLabel:SetText("Absorb from your bags:") else shelfLabel:SetText("Absorb: no weapon or armour with random enchants in your bags.") end end
-- The server link ---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function request() B.pending = true send("OPEN") end
function RustWrathBottle_Act(action, si) if B.selected == nil or B.pending then return end B.pending = true RustWrathBottle_Render() send("ACT\t" .. action .. "\t" .. B.selected .. "\t" .. si) end
local listener = CreateFrame("Frame") listener:RegisterEvent("CHAT_MSG_ADDON") listener:SetScript("OnEvent", function(_, ev, prefix, msg) prefix = prefix or arg1 msg = msg or arg2 if prefix ~= PREFIX or type(msg) ~= "string" then return end local f = split(msg) local verb = f[1] if verb == "BEGIN" then incoming = { charges = tonumber(f[2]) or 0, stored = tonumber(f[3]) or 0, storedTier = tonumber(f[4]) or 0, pour = tonumber(f[5]) or 0, awaken = tonumber(f[6]) or 0, storedName = f[7] or "", items = {}, absorb = {} } elseif verb == "ITEM" and incoming then local item = { equip = tonumber(f[2]), entry = tonumber(f[3]) or 0, slots = {} } for si = 1, 3 do local at = 3 + (si - 1) * 5 item.slots[si] = { id = tonumber(f[at + 1]) or 0, tier = tonumber(f[at + 2]) or 0, reroll = tonumber(f[at + 3]) or 0, empower = tonumber(f[at + 4]) or 0, name = f[at + 5] or "" } end if item.equip then table.insert(incoming.items, item) end elseif verb == "ABS" and incoming then local bag, slot = tonumber(f[2]), tonumber(f[3]) if bag and slot then table.insert(incoming.absorb, { bag = bag, slot = slot, entry = tonumber(f[4]) or 0, value = tonumber(f[5]) or 0, name = f[6] or "?" }) end elseif verb == "END" and incoming then for key, value in pairs(incoming) do B[key] = value end incoming = nil B.pending = false if not selected_item() then B.selected = B.items[1] and B.items[1].equip or nil end if frame:IsShown() then RustWrathBottle_Render() end elseif verb == "MSG" then status:SetText(f[2] or "") -- A result outside a request of ours (a disenchant) refreshes the panel. if frame:IsShown() and not B.pending then request() end end end)
frame:SetScript("OnShow", function() status:SetText("") RustWrathBottle_Render() request() end)
function RustWrathBottle_Toggle() if frame:IsShown() then frame:Hide() else frame:Show() end end
-- Opening it: the bottle from the bags or the action bar, or /bottle ------------------
local function busy() return (MerchantFrame and MerchantFrame:IsShown()) or (BankFrame and BankFrame:IsShown()) or (TradeFrame and TradeFrame:IsShown()) or (SendMailFrame and SendMailFrame:IsVisible()) or (AuctionFrame and AuctionFrame:IsShown()) or (GuildBankFrame and GuildBankFrame:IsShown()) or (SpellCanTargetItem and SpellCanTargetItem()) end
local function container_item_id(bag, slot) local id = GetContainerItemID and GetContainerItemID(bag, slot) if not id then local link = GetContainerItemLink(bag, slot) id = link and tonumber(link:match("item:(%d+)")) end return id end
-- Deviation: the bottle's stock spell would show a placement cursor; RustWrath opens the -- panel instead. Everything else, and the bottle at a vendor, bank, trade, mail or auction -- window or under a spell waiting for an item, goes to the native use. local useContainerItem = UseContainerItem function UseContainerItem(bag, slot, ...) local id = container_item_id(bag, slot) if id and BOTTLE_ITEMS[id] and not busy() then RustWrathBottle_Toggle() return end return useContainerItem(bag, slot, ...) end
local useAction = UseAction function UseAction(action, ...) local kind, id = GetActionInfo(action) if kind == "item" and BOTTLE_ITEMS[id] then RustWrathBottle_Toggle() return end return useAction(action, ...) end
SLASH_RUSTWRATHBOTTLE1 = "/bottle" SlashCmdList["RUSTWRATHBOTTLE"] = function() RustWrathBottle_Toggle() end
